# R

Persistent R subprocess. Requires `knitr`, `jsonlite`, and `base64enc` for rich output; degrades to plain text without them.

## 1. Plain output — expect `answer: 42`

```r
x <- 40 + 2
cat("answer:", x, "\n")
```
<!-- nb-output hash="21fed3f86e047a8b" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<pre class="nb-stream-stdout">answer: 42 

</pre>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 2. Auto-print — expect `[1] 42` (visible result of last expression prints)

```r
x
```
<!-- nb-output hash="3b1382c0725ce77d" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<pre class="nb-stream-stdout">[1] 42

</pre>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 3. Data frame — expect a rendered HTML table, not base64 text

```r
data.frame(name = c("Alice", "Bob"), score = c(92, 85))
```
<!-- nb-output hash="84a51840f1263d9f" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<div class="nb-output-html"><table class="nb-table">
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th style="text-align:left;"> name </th>
   <th style="text-align:right;"> score </th>
  </tr>
 </thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
   <td style="text-align:left;"> Alice </td>
   <td style="text-align:right;"> 92 </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
   <td style="text-align:left;"> Bob </td>
   <td style="text-align:right;"> 85 </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table></div>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 4. Plot — expect an inline PNG (and no Rplots.pdf created anywhere)

```r
plot(1:10, main = "r plot")
```
<!-- nb-output hash="fb96f487a3ddc701" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<img class="nb-output-image" src="data:image/png;base64," />
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 5. Plot saved to vault — expect `![](r-plot.png)` and the file next to this note

```r {format=image id=r-plot}
plot(cos, -pi, pi)
```
<!-- nb-output id="r-plot" hash="64405d1a79d5dcea" format="image" -->
![](r-plot.png)
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 6. Message — expect `heads up from R` in red (R messages go to stderr)

```r
message("heads up from R")
```
<!-- nb-output hash="070954a157494177" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<pre class="nb-stream-stderr">heads up from R
</pre>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 7. Error — expect `Error: deliberate failure` in red (cell completes; kernel survives)

```r
stop("deliberate failure")
```
<!-- nb-output hash="177b54797cc222f3" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<pre class="nb-stream-stderr">Error: deliberate failure
</pre>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

## 8. Kernel survived the error — expect `[1] 84` (`x` still defined)

```r
x * 2
```
<!-- nb-output hash="9829e2ca02747e37" format="html" -->
<div class="nb-output">
<pre class="nb-stream-stdout">[1] 84

</pre>
</div>
<!-- /nb-output -->

> [!note] Known limitations
> Plots are captured per cell — you can't add to a previous cell's plot with `lines()`/`points()` in a later cell. If one cell draws multiple plots, only the last is kept.
